context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 72 verified Server-Side SEO and PDF Cover features. Key findings: (1) SSR endpoint at /api/ssr/plano/{slug} returns complete HTML page with all OG meta tags, Twitter cards, schema.org TouristTrip, canonical URL, and full itinerary content - crawlers can parse without JavaScript. (2) OG image endpoint generates premium 24KB PNG with dark gradient design, 4Luis branding, destination, duration, dates. (3) PDF with slug parameter generates larger PDF (~20KB+) with cover page using OG image. (4) PDF without slug still works for backward compatibility. (5) setupProxy.js intercepts crawler user agents and redirects to SSR endpoint. Note: Cache-Control header on OG image is overridden by Cloudflare proxy - this is infrastructure-level, not a code issue.
